title: Sales Data Kit Deploy vs Preserving Custom DLO–DMO Maps

steps.prompt: A mature Data 360 org has customized Contact and Account DLO-to-DMO mappings that feed identity resolution and activation. Enabling Marketing Cloud Next requires the Sales Data Kit, whose consent and messaging streams the team needs. How should the architect bring in the kit?

options.label: Run the Deploy Data Streams step in Marketing Cloud Next setup to reconcile the mappings
options.rationale: The setup deploy reapplies the kit's predefined DLO-to-DMO mappings over the custom ones, breaking the identity resolution and activation built on them.

options.label: Keep the custom mappings and point segments and activations at the DLOs instead
options.rationale: Segmentation and activation build on the harmonized DMO layer, so moving them to DLOs gives up the canonical model that identity resolution unifies.

options.label: Deploy only the kit's consent and messaging streams and map them beside the custom mappings
options.rationale: DMOs are the harmonized layer that identity resolution and activation read, so the custom DLO-to-DMO mappings must stay intact. Bringing in only the streams Marketing Cloud Next needs adds consent and messaging data without replacing those mappings.
